# Copilot instructions for BliKVM website and documentation

## Build and validation commands

- Install dependencies with `yarn`. The repo is pinned to Yarn 1 and requires Node.js 18+.
- Start the local site with `yarn start`.
- Start the Chinese locale locally with `yarn start --locale zh-CN`.
- Create the production build with `yarn build`.
- Preview the built site with `yarn serve`.
- Export a single Markdown doc to PDF with `yarn export:pdf "docs/<path>.md" "exports/<name>.pdf"`.
- There are currently no `test` or `lint` scripts in `package.json`, so there is no repo-native single-test command.

## High-level architecture

- This is a Docusaurus site using the classic preset. `docusaurus.config.js` defines the site-wide navbar, footer, Algolia search, locales, custom CSS, and deployment branch.
- `docs/` is the source of the English documentation set, and `sidebars.js` manually defines the docs information architecture and ordering. The sidebar is not autogenerated, so new docs usually need matching sidebar updates.
- `blog/` holds announcement-style posts. Blog posts use frontmatter such as `slug`, `title`, `authors`, and `tags`.
- `src/pages/` contains custom React pages for the homepage, product listing, download, partner page, and comparison pages under `src/pages/product/`. These pages are mostly driven by hard-coded arrays of product metadata, media links, and locale-aware store URLs instead of a shared data layer.
- `static/` stores site assets and product imagery. Pages and docs reference these assets with site-absolute paths like `/img/...` and `/assets/...`.
- Chinese localization is split by content type:
  - translated docs live under `i18n/zh-CN/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/current/`
  - sidebar label translations live in `i18n/zh-CN/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/current.json`
  - React/page/theme string translations live in `i18n/zh-CN/code.json`
  - navbar/footer label overrides live in `i18n/zh-CN/docusaurus-theme-classic/`
- `scripts/export-doc-pdf.mjs` is a custom doc export path. It rewrites site-absolute asset links, converts Docusaurus admonitions and embedded iframes into PDF-friendly Markdown, writes temp files into `.pdf-tmp/`, and then renders with `md-to-pdf`.
- `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` builds with Yarn on pushes to `master`, publishes `build/` to `gh-pages`, and also uploads the built site to the production server.

## Key conventions

- When you change a doc that already has a Chinese counterpart, update both the English source in `docs/` and the mirrored file under `i18n/zh-CN/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/current/`.
- When you add or rename a docs category label in `sidebars.js`, update `i18n/zh-CN/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/current.json` so the translated sidebar stays in sync.
- When you edit text wrapped in `<Translate>` in React pages, update the matching keys in `i18n/zh-CN/code.json`.
- Locale-specific external links are usually stored inline in page components as objects keyed by locale, with English as the fallback. Follow that pattern when adding new storefront or media links.
- The homepage contains custom locale behavior: it remembers explicit language switches in `localStorage` and auto-redirects Chinese browsers from `/` to `/zh-CN/` only when no preference has been saved. Preserve that behavior when changing locale logic.
- Keep asset references site-absolute (`/img/...`, `/assets/...`) instead of relative filesystem paths so they work in Docusaurus pages and in the PDF export rewrite step.

## Release notes

For GitHub Release work, follow `releases/README.md` and start from `releases/TEMPLATE.md`. Keep English and Chinese equivalent. Use actual asset URLs, preserve release tags/assets/status unless explicitly requested, and validate via `scripts/release-notes.mjs` before updating a release body.
